replicateSelect.label: Replicate
replicateSelect.helpTable: When this table is served from its replica: a copy kept in the engine's store and refreshed on the table's timeliness settings (TTL, freshness check, change feed). It is not a continuous change stream. Default uses the source's value, or the global threshold when the source has none. Only Always is a guarantee; Default, Never and the Hot entries are best effort.
replicateSelect.helpSource: When this source's tables are served from their replicas: copies kept in the engine's store and refreshed on each table's timeliness settings. A table with no value of its own uses this one. Default applies the global threshold. Only Always is a guarantee; Default, Never and the Hot entries are best effort.
replicateSelect.neverWithLoadProtection: Never cannot be combined with load protection: a load-protected table is never read live.
